column2: Paano gumamit ng ReAct para sa multi-step problems?
column4: I-prompt ang model na mag-thought, action, at observation loop hanggang sa final answer.

column2: Paano i-set ang role ng model?
column4: Sa system prompt: 'You are a helpful software engineer'.

column2: Paano i-constrain ang topic ng sagot?
column4: Sabihin: 'Only answer questions about Python programming'.
Magdagdag ng constraint: 'Answer in one short paragraph'.

column2: Paano i-adapt ang tone ng model?
column4: I-specify sa prompt: 'Use a professional and friendly tone'.
